title: Lantern Tide - the river does the moving

beats.visual: Black screen; one paper lantern lights up on dark water.
beats.voiceover: What if you never touched the lantern?
beats.caption: What if the river did it?

beats.visual: A finger drags a stone into the stream; the current curls around it.
beats.voiceover: In Lantern Tide you only bend the current.
beats.caption: You bend the current

beats.visual: The lantern drifts along the new curve and passes a reed gate.
beats.caption: The river carries it

beats.visual: Wide shot of a single-screen level: three stones, two gates, one lantern.
beats.voiceover: Every level fits on one screen.
beats.caption: One screen, one puzzle

beats.visual: Two lanterns split at a fork and meet again downstream.
beats.voiceover: Add a stone. Split the stream. Watch them meet.
beats.caption: Split it. Let them meet.

beats.visual: Night sky reflected in the water; fireflies follow the lanterns.
beats.caption: Calm, even when it's hard

beats.visual: Platform logos rise like lanterns: PC, Switch, Android.
beats.voiceover: Out this Friday on PC, Switch and Android.
beats.caption: Friday: PC, Switch, Android

beats.visual: Store page on a phone; a thumb taps the wishlist button.
beats.voiceover: Add it to your wishlist so Friday finds you.
beats.caption: Wishlist it before Friday

beats.visual: The lantern from the first shot floats back into frame.
beats.voiceover: And then let the river work.
beats.caption: Then let it flow

beats.visual: Same framing as the opening shot: one lantern on dark water.
beats.caption: What if the river did it?
